title: 5G NR LDPC typestate builder preset
description:
## Goal

5G NR LDPC chain preset via the typestate fluent builder: any
(BG, lifting set, rate) tuple in scope expressible with compile-time
parameter validation.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR + research enablers) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §9 (typestate builder
machinery — reused from Phase A `81d05bab`). Sequencing: depends on
`acf9b11a` (BG tables + shift tables exist).

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/presets/nr_5g.rs`:
   - `Pipeline::nr_5g() -> Builder<NeedsBaseGraph>` entry point.
   - Builder methods: `.base_graph(BG)`, `.lifting_set(i_LS)`,
     `.lifting_size(Z)`, `.rate(NrRate)`, `.decoder()`, `.demap()`,
     `.channel()`, `.parallelism()`, `.seed()`, `.checkpoint_dir()`.
   - `Builder<Ready>::build()` returns
     `Result<Pipeline, BuildError>` with parameter validation:
     - `(i_LS, Z)` consistency per TS 38.212 Table 5.3.2-1.
     - `rate` allowed for the chosen `BG`.
2. Reuse:
   - The graph wiring (BCH-equivalent? 5G NR has no outer code at
     the LDPC layer; the chain is encode → interleave → modulate →
     channel → demap → deinterleave → decode) constructed via the
     graph API (`c09d3e95`).
   - The `LdpcEncoder` and `LdpcDecoder` Stage impls already in
     `gf2-sim` are parameterised by base graph + shift table; the
     preset feeds them the 5G NR variants from `acf9b11a`.
3. Doctest example in the rustdoc of `Pipeline::nr_5g()` showing
   a full builder chain producing a working pipeline for BG1,
   `i_LS` = 8, `Z` = 384, rate 1/2.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] 5G NR LDPC chain expressible via the typestate builder
  for every (BG, lifting set, rate) combination in scope; doctest
  passes for the BG1 / Z=384 / r1/2 case.
- [hard] Compile-time check on parameter combinations: a wrong
  call order (e.g. `.lifting_size()` before `.base_graph()`)
  fails to typecheck.
- [hard] Runtime validation at `.build()`: invalid (`i_LS`, `Z`,
  `BG`, rate) combinations yield a typed `BuildError`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- GPU kernel tuning (owned by `23d3525f`).
- Encoder GPU offload (epic non-goal).
